quest.title: Tatara Tales: Data Collection
quest.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, such perfect timing, Traveler! The data has almost all been gathered, and it is now time to retrieve our beacons!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: That I shall, that I shall. Best to be quick, and sneaky too. Don't let those Fatui spot you!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: These beacons always come with very detailed instruction manuals.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: These describe various different circumstances and the amount of time required for data-gathering in each circumstance.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: As for unknown forms of energy like Tatarigami, I will simply consider them to require the longest duration. Either way, the task of retrieving those beacons falls to you.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: How did it go? Do you have all our beacons?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Bravo! Now, just give me a moment while I modify this device.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I must say, the Fatui have been acting more and more strangely recently. They seem to be gathering around the core of the furnace.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hopefully, they aren't hatching some other dastardly plot. Or should I say, trying to do something that we won't be able to mitigate...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Now, all we need to do is wait for our beacons to collect enough data.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Once we have that data on hand, I will make a few tweaks to this device accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Once all is ready, let us put a decisive end to this incident.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: If we are able to acquire this data, then this should make our job a lot easier.
